positions.title: Principal
positions.description: Software development consulting relating to previous work at Shearwater GeoServices.

positions.title: VP Open Geophysical
positions.description:
Open Geophysical was purchased by Dolphin Geophysical in April 2012. Shearwater GeoServices acquired a number of assets of Dolphin, including the OpenCPS seismic processing software.

I continued contributing to the software. I also worked on sales, marketing, and product management/strategy.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
I co-founded Open Geophysical to develop the OpenCPS seismic processing software. I wrote 100k+ lines of C++ and Java code during the first two years, and did a lot of pre-sales demos.

We sold the company to Dolphin Geophysical (now Shearwater Geoservices) in 2012.

I also wrote/contributed to a number of the core geophysical modules in OpenCPS/Reveal, including:
* N-d interpolation plus some tricks to make it fast
* Kirchhoff PSTM/PSDM
* Tomography
* SRME
* too many signal processing tools to list: decon, radon, deghosting, swell-noise removal, etc.

I also worked on several external research & development projects, including:
* Shallow-water demultiple collaboration with a big oil co
* General infrastructure for patching (with various windows, overlaps, etc.) algorithms and distributing patches with hierarchy of (a) breaking into independent jobs, (b) MPI, (c) OpenMP

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on two new software products, PolicyCenter and BillingCenter, through their v1.0 launches. I joined BillingCenter as the second software engineer and third team member.
